parts.text:
The range of angles measured in this experiment may be quite small. Using the same
apparatus, with the masses and spring in the same positions, suggest another method of
investigating as reliably as possible the extent by which the rule is pulled down by the
masses. This method must not use a protractor but an additional rule may be used. You may
draw a diagram if you wish.
